title: _rrep_seen dict never gets periodic pruning in discovery.py: Unlike _seen which is pruned every 16 RREQ checks via _prune_seen(), the _rrep_seen replay cache only prunes on overflow at 1024 entries. This resource management inconsistency could lead to higher memory usage for RREP-heavy traffic. Line 413-415 should also prune _rrep_seen.
